opportunities.name: EdUHK Research Postgraduate Studentship
eligibility_clues: All full-time students admitted to the UGC-funded Research Postgraduate (RPg) Programmes are automatically considered
No separate application is required
Given based on academic merit; the award is not taxable income
Tenable on an annual basis; later years depend on satisfactory performance
Holders may also receive government loans and grants and other scholarships if the other awards allow it
Duties assigned by the University shall not exceed, on average, 10 working hours per week
PhD and MPhil are full-time; the PhD is described as covering fields such as education, humanities, social sciences, cultural and creative arts, and science
Department of Mathematics and Information Technology offers PhD and MPhil with Area of Focus: Mathematics and Computer Science
opportunities.amount: HK$19,100 (approximately US$2,440) for all MPhil and PhD students and HK$19,600 (approximately US$2,450) for post-candidacy PhD students
opportunities.amount_note: The monthly stipend for the 2026/27 academic year is HK$19,100 (approximately US$2,440) for all MPhil and PhD students and HK$19,600 (approximately US$2,450) for post-candidacy PhD students. The page does not print a 2027/28 rate.
opportunities.deadline_note: The studentship page prints no application deadline. The September 2027 Intake (Semester 1, 2027/28) application deadline on the Graduate School pages is 1 December 2026. The January 2027 intake deadline printed as 11 September 2026 is earlier than this scout date.
opportunities.match_rationale: This is the university monthly studentship for full-time UGC-funded PhD and MPhil students, so a local applicant is in the eligible population, and MIT's Mathematics and Computer Science area sits inside that RPg route. The printed stipend year is 2026/27 while the open admission round on the same Graduate School site is September 2027.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Automatic on admission to full-time UGC-funded RPg. Open programme round is September 2027 (2027/28), deadline 1 December 2026. Printed stipend year is 2026/27.
restrictions: Assigned duties up to an average of 10 working hours per week

opportunities.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
eligibility_clues: EdUHK PhD applicants submit an initial HKPFS application and a full EdUHK application quoting the HKPFS reference number

RGC eligibility: new full-time PhD students in the eight listed universities, including The Education University of Hong Kong, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience and ethnic background
Applicants should demonstrate academic performance, research ability or potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities
EdUHK named areas include Mathematics Education under Education; the page also says for other research areas see the EdUHK repository
MIT is listed as a PhD supervision department and states Area of Focus: Mathematics and Computer Science
Additional monthly stipend from the Graduate School for the normative 4-year PhD is subject to approval of the individual application
One-year tuition fee waiver for the 4th year of a 4-year PhD does not apply if tuition is already fully waived, including by the Tuition Waiver for Local Research Postgraduate Students
RGC index: 400 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in the 2027/28 academic year
opportunities.amount: monthly stipend of HK$28,700 (approx. US$3,660) and a conference travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approx. US$1,840) per year for up to three years
opportunities.amount_note: EdUHK page: Provides a monthly stipend of HK$28,700 (approx. US$3,660) and a conference travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approx. US$1,840) per year for up to three years. That page does not label the academic year of this monthly figure. The RGC index page prints a different presentation for the 2026/27 academic year: an annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) and a conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) per year. The additional Graduate School monthly stipend has no printed HKD amount. The 2027/28 poster was behind a sign-in page and was not used.
opportunities.deadline_note: The EdUHK HKPFS page does not print a date. The RGC apply page prints The Education University of Hong Kong Application Deadline: 1 December 2026 (11:59pm Hong Kong Time), and an initial-application deadline of 1 December 2026 at Hong Kong Time 12:00:00. The EdUHK application-process page prints HKPFS Application Deadline: 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon (Hong Kong Time) for the initial RGC application, and September 2027 Intake application deadline 1 December 2026.
opportunities.match_rationale: HKPFS is a PhD fellowship with a monthly stipend, EdUHK is a participating university, and local students are not excluded because eligibility is irrespective of country of origin. The 2027/28 round is open. Mathematics Education is the named education area; computational mathematics is not named there, but MIT's PhD area of focus is Mathematics and Computer Science and staff research includes applied and computational mathematics.
opportunities.intake_relevance: HKPFS 2027/28. EdUHK full-application deadline printed by RGC as 1 December 2026 (11:59pm Hong Kong Time). Stipend year is not labelled 2027/28 on the EdUHK page; the RGC annual figure is labelled 2026/27.
restrictions: Competitive selection on academic excellence, research ability and potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership
Fourth-year tuition waiver is unavailable if another scheme already waives tuition in full
Year-4 Graduate School stipend is subject to approval and has no printed amount
On-campus accommodation is subject to hall policy and availability

opportunities.name: Tuition Waiver for Local Research Postgraduate Students
eligibility_clues: Starting from the 2018/19 academic year, local students enrolled in UGC-funded RPg programmes
UGC page: non-means-tested tuition waiver for all eligible local full-time students; unlimited number of recipients
Covers the normative study period: MPhil 2 years; PhD with a research master's degree 3 years; PhD without a research master's degree 4 years
The Education University of Hong Kong is one of the eight named universities
Both current and new RPg students are eligible

From the 2027/28 academic year, Category I subsidised fees include a person holding a Hong Kong permanent identity card, other documents issued by the ImmD showing the right to land or right of abode in Hong Kong, and a visa label for unconditional stay
A one-year transitional residency requirement applies for the 2027/28 academic year; the two-year residency requirement starts in 2028/29
Students whose tuition is fully waived by another scheme cannot also take this waiver
opportunities.amount_note: The UGC page says waived tuition fees for eligible students and that the scheme covers the tuition fees for the normative study period. It does not print a HKD amount. The EdUHK PhD/MPhil fees table prints Tuition Fee HK$47,000/annum for UGC-funded students for 2026/27, provisional and subject to adjustment. That fee line is not stated as the waiver amount.
opportunities.deadline_note: No application deadline is printed. The UGC page says eligible local students need not apply for the waiver in the related HKPFS enquiry material; the waiver page itself says students covered by the scheme no longer qualify for TSFS tuition-fee grants.
opportunities.match_rationale: A Hong Kong permanent resident on a full-time UGC-funded PhD or MPhil, including through MIT, is in the population this waiver names, and the 2027/28 eligibility revision is already printed. It waives tuition rather than paying a monthly living stipend.
opportunities.intake_relevance: In force for UGC-funded RPg, with a printed eligibility revision for the 2027/28 academic year and thereafter. Application cycle for 2027/28 is described as commencing in October 2026.
restrictions: No double benefit with another full tuition waiver
Part-time RPg programmes are not UGC-funded

opportunities.name: Sir Edward Youde Memorial Fellowships (for Postgraduate Research Students)
eligibility_clues: The fellowships ($50,000 each) are available to full-time postgraduate research students undertaking UGC-funded/ publicly-funded programmes who have registered for a master's degree or a doctorate degree
Applicants must be HK permanent residents and have resided in HK for at least three years
Normally open for application in September and subject to selection
The Graduate School also lists the Sir Edward Youde Memorial Fellowship among other scholarship schemes for research postgraduate students
opportunities.amount_note: The fellowships ($50,000 each) are available to full-time postgraduate research students. The calendar does not say per month or per year.
opportunities.deadline: Normally open for application in September
opportunities.deadline_note: Normally open for application in September and subject to selection. No calendar year or day is printed.
opportunities.match_rationale: A local Hong Kong permanent resident already registered on a full-time UGC-funded MPhil or PhD can be considered, and the field is not restricted. It is a fellowship of $50,000 each, not the monthly postgraduate studentship.
opportunities.intake_relevance: For students who have registered. The September application window is not tied to a printed year, so it is not labelled as the 2027/28 admission round.
restrictions: HK permanent resident with at least three years' residence in Hong Kong
Full-time UGC-funded or publicly-funded research master's or doctorate

opportunities.name: Research Students' Attachment Scheme (RSAS)
eligibility_clues: Offers PhD students a research attachment of up to three months at an overseas host university
Eligible full-time UGC-funded PhD students who have successfully passed the qualifying examination may apply
Students who have completed the Scheme are required to submit a post-visit report and fulfill the publication requirements
opportunities.amount: Monthly Sponsorship for Living Expenses: Up to HK$7,500; Travel Allowance: Up to HK$10,000
opportunities.amount_note: Successful applicants will be provided with Monthly Sponsorship for Living Expenses: Up to HK$7,500 and Travel Allowance: Up to HK$10,000. The page does not print how many months the monthly sponsorship lasts beyond the attachment of up to three months.
opportunities.deadline_note: No application deadline is printed on the programme page. Guidelines and the application form are linked but were not opened as separate fetched documents.
opportunities.match_rationale: A local full-time UGC-funded PhD student, including one supervised in MIT, may apply after the qualifying examination. The support is a short overseas attachment grant, not the monthly studentship for the degree.
opportunities.intake_relevance: For enrolled PhD students after the qualifying examination, not an admission award for the September 2027 intake.
restrictions: Full-time UGC-funded and qualifying examination passed
Attachment of up to three months

opportunities.name: Research Support
eligibility_clues: Graduate School: PhD and MPhil students who have passed the Qualifying Presentation and confirmed their candidature are eligible to apply
Faculty of Education and Human Development page: research support such as equipment, general expenses, hiring of student helper and research/fieldwork-related expenses
Current-student guidelines on the Graduate School student-support page are behind login
opportunities.amount_note: FEHD page: up to an amount of HKD$10,000 per year (maximum 2 years for PhD candidate and 1 year for MPhil). The Graduate School scholarship page describes the same support and does not print a HKD figure. The cap is printed on a Faculty of Education and Human Development page; MIT is listed under FLASS.
opportunities.deadline_note: No deadline is printed.
opportunities.match_rationale: This is research-expense support after confirmation of candidature, not a living stipend. The HKD cap is printed on the FEHD research-students page, while a computing-mathematics supervisor would sit in MIT under FLASS, so the page does not state that this cap applies to MIT.
opportunities.intake_relevance: After the Qualifying Presentation and confirmation of candidature. Not an intake award.
restrictions: Printed cap is on the FEHD page
Maximum 2 years for a PhD candidate and 1 year for MPhil

opportunities.name: Conference, Workshop or Immersion Visit Support
eligibility_clues: Financial support would be provided to RPg students to attend international, national, or local conferences or workshops and immersion visits relevant to their research and thesis
FAQ: PhD and MPhil students who have passed the qualifying examination and confirmed their candidature are eligible to apply for research support and conference support
opportunities.amount_note: Neither the Graduate School page nor the FEHD research-students page prints a HKD amount for conference, workshop, or immersion-visit support. The supervisor financial-support page has no amounts.
opportunities.deadline_note: No deadline is printed. Current-student application guidelines are on a login page.
opportunities.match_rationale: Enrolled PhD and MPhil students can apply for conference or visit support after confirmation of candidature. No stipend figure is printed, and this is not the monthly studentship.
opportunities.intake_relevance: For enrolled RPg students after the qualifying examination. Not an admission award for 2027/28.
restrictions: Activity must be relevant to the thesis

opportunities.name: Part-time research or teaching assistantships
eligibility_clues: FAQ: contingent on satisfactory progress and availability of funding, research centres or academic units may offer part-time assistantships (research assistantships or teaching assistantships) to research students
Applicants are advised to discuss this with the department or research centre
opportunities.amount_note: The FAQ does not print a HKD rate.
opportunities.deadline_note: No deadline is printed.
opportunities.match_rationale: A research student in MIT or another unit might be offered a part-time assistantship, but the FAQ states it depends on funding and does not give an amount or a 2027/28 round.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Not an advertised 2027/28 admission award. The FAQ footer reads July 2024.
restrictions: Subject to satisfactory progress and availability of funding
Arranged with the department or research centre

opportunities.amount_note: Scholarships ($5,000 each for undergraduates and $20,000 each for postgraduates). The calendar does not say per month.
opportunities.deadline: Normally open for application around September
opportunities.deadline_note: Normally open for application around September and subject to selection by the donor. No year is printed.
opportunities.match_rationale: The Graduate School lists this among schemes for research postgraduate students, and the calendar prints a postgraduate amount. It is a donor scholarship for women university students, not a monthly studentship, and it is not limited to mathematics.
opportunities.intake_relevance: September application window with no printed year. Not labelled 2027/28.
restrictions: Women university students, as described on the Graduate School page

opportunities.amount_note: Reaching Out Award – $10,000 each for local/ non-local students to participate in activities outside Hong Kong.
opportunities.deadline: normally open for application from September
opportunities.deadline_note: The scholarships (a) to (d) above are normally open for application from September. No year or day is printed.
opportunities.match_rationale: Local full-time UGC-funded students can be considered, and the FEHD research-students page ties the award to outreach such as IOSP. It is a one-off activity award of $10,000 each, not a monthly studentship.
opportunities.intake_relevance: September application window with no printed year. Not an admission stipend for 2027/28.
restrictions: For participation in activities outside Hong Kong
Outstanding academic results and non-academic achievements

opportunities.name: Cross-institutional Course/Subject Enrolment Scheme tuition waiver
eligibility_clues: Research Postgraduate (RPg) students are eligible to apply for enrolment in the courses listed for the Cross-institutional Course/Subject Enrolment Scheme

Waivers of tuition fees will be granted to eligible students
Grades are given with an official transcript from the host university

opportunities.deadline_note: No deadline is printed on the FEHD page.
opportunities.match_rationale: An enrolled RPg student can have tuition waived for a listed course at another UGC university. This is a course-fee waiver, not a living stipend, and the text is on the FEHD research-students page.
opportunities.intake_relevance: For enrolled RPg students. Not an admission award.

opportunities.name: EdUHK PhD Scholarship for Outstanding Graduates from Selected Institutions
eligibility_clues: Awarded to outstanding graduates from selected institutions who demonstrate exceptional potential for PhD studies at EdUHK
Two categories: graduates from top-ranked universities worldwide, and graduates from EdUHK's strategic partner institutions, with priority given to candidates from Belt and Road countries
EdUHK academic staff make internal nominations; the detailed PDF is behind a Microsoft sign-in
The public page does not say the scheme is closed to Hong Kong permanent residents
opportunities.amount: Monthly Stipend: HK$19,100 # * (for up to three years)
opportunities.amount_note: Monthly Stipend: HK$19,100 # * (for up to three years). The monthly stipend for post-candidacy PhD students will be increased to HK$19,600*. Conference and Research-related Travel Allowance: HK$31,000* (for the entire period of study). The asterisk is defined as in the 2026/27 academic year. The institution list was not readable.

opportunities.match_rationale: The award is a PhD monthly stipend, but it is limited to graduates of selected institutions and gives priority to Belt and Road candidates. opportunities.intake_relevance: PhD scholarship with rates marked for the 2026/27 academic year. No 2027/28 deadline is printed. Detailed terms were not public.
restrictions: Priority to candidates from Belt and Road countries
Stipend wording is for up to three years

Must not simultaneously register for another qualification

opportunities.deadline_note: Normally open for application in September and subject to selection. No year is printed.

Programmes of one year or above

opportunities.name: Tertiary Student Finance Scheme - Publicly-funded Programmes (TSFS)
eligibility_clues: UGC-funded full-time students can apply for TSFS
Assistance is a grant and/or loan. The grant is to cover tuition fees and academic expenses. The loan is for living expenses
The level of grant and/or loan is determined by adjusted family income and net asset value per household member

UGC tuition-waiver page: students covered by the local RPg tuition waiver will no longer qualify for tuition fee grants under TSFS, but eligible students may still apply for means-tested grants and loans under TSFS to cover academic and living expenses respectively
opportunities.amount_note: No fixed HKD award is printed. The calendar says the loan is interest-bearing at the rate of 1.0% per annum and repayable in 180 monthly instalments within 15 years. That interest rate is not an award amount.
opportunities.deadline_note: The calendar does not print a TSFS application date. It does print an Extended Non-means-tested Loan Scheme deadline of 31 July 2027 for the 2026/27 academic year, which is a different scheme.
opportunities.match_rationale: A local full-time UGC-funded student may still seek means-tested help with academic and living expenses, but the RPg tuition waiver removes the TSFS tuition-fee grant, and TSFS is a means-tested grant and loan rather than a postgraduate studentship.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Means-tested aid for UGC-funded full-time study. Not labelled as a 2027/28 stipend.
restrictions: Tuition-fee grant is not available when the local RPg tuition waiver applies

opportunities.name: EdUHK Scholarship Scheme for Outstanding International Students of the Self-financed Research Postgraduate Programmes
